id.description: TSID of the contact record being replaced; present only on updates and tombstones.

account.description: Account the contact is written for, set only when a delegated key signs on its behalf.

subject.description: The account being described; an empty subject makes the blob a tombstone.

name.description: The signer's name for the subject account, up to 256 bytes.

subscribe.description: Flags saying whether the signer joined the subject's site or follows its profile.

description: A public address-book entry: one account's name for another, with flags for joining its site or following its profile.
